instruction: Candid family photograph, medium wide shot. In a sunny park lined with tall palm trees under a clear blue sky, the man in the maroon polo shirt (R1) carries the young girl in the pink tie-dye dress (R2) on his shoulders. The man (R1) points upward with his right arm, looking up, while the young girl (R2) smiles and looks in the same direction. To the left, the woman in the blue sleeveless top (R3) stands smiling, looking up with her hand placed gently on her chest. Bright, direct sunlight fills the scene.
elements: R1 carries R2 on his shoulders
R1 supports R2's weight from below rather than being carried by R2
R2 rides on R1's shoulders as the carried person

R3 stands nearby smiling and looking up, not participating in the shoulder-carry
